contents.text: Good morning, I'm Orbi, Louis's AI agent. This is the top of the page, and it says your doors close at five, but your website doesn't. The website answers the question someone asks at 11 at night, and has their details ready for you in the morning.

arguments.question: Shall we carry on down the page?

choices.label: On to what it does
choices.why: The four things it does for every visitor.

choices.label: Explain where it runs
choices.why: Where your data lives and who hosts it.

choices.label: Stop here
choices.why: We can pick this up another time.
